annotations.text:
A. Bubbly Scrapbook
Why: feels handmade and personal, like Emrie's own craft project. Tilted polaroids, washi tape, sticker badges, handwritten captions.
Tradeoff: busier; needs real photos to sing, and the tilts take care on phones.

B. Bright Poster
Why: loud, confident, big type and flat color blocks, like a party flyer. Reads instantly on a phone.
Tradeoff: less 'made by a kid', more 'brand'. Relies on bold copy staying short.
